title: Semantic search over your notes
goal: Search your own notes by meaning, not keywords, and get cited answers.
steps: Load notes and split by heading
Embed and index with metadata (path, date, tags)
Add BM25 and fuse with vector results
Answer with an LLM that cites note paths
Re-index only changed files by content hash
stretch: Agent tool: search_notes exposed via MCP
done: 20-question golden set with recall@5 ≥ 0.8
Every answer cites at least one note
Incremental re-index under 10 s for one changed note

title: Your own MCP server to a database
goal: Let any MCP client (Claude, Cursor, your agent) safely query and update a real database.
steps: Design 4 task-shaped tools (search, get, query_metric, create_task)
Use a read-only role for read tools
Cap rows and response size; paginate
Require confirmation for the write tool
Log every call with arguments and caller
done: Works from 2 different MCP clients
Injection test: a row containing instructions does not trigger writes
20 task scenarios with ≥ 90% success

title: Function calling that books real calendar meetings
goal: An assistant that finds free slots and books meetings on your real calendar.
stack: Google Calendar or Microsoft Graph API
steps: Define tools: find_free_slots, create_event, cancel_event with strict schemas
Handle time zones explicitly (store UTC, display local)
Confirm before creating or cancelling
Use idempotency keys so retries never double-book
Log tool calls and results
done: 30 scheduling requests with ≥ 95% correct slot and time zone
Zero double bookings under retry tests
Never books without confirmation

title: Evals that catch prompt regressions
goal: A CI gate that blocks a prompt or model change when quality drops.
steps: Do error analysis on 50 real outputs
Build a 60-case golden set with per-failure-mode assertions
Add one calibrated judge for a subjective criterion
Run in CI on every PR and compare to main
Block merges on significant drops
stretch: Online evals on sampled production traffic
done: A deliberately bad prompt change is blocked
Judge agreement with your labels ≥ 85% on held-out cases
Suite runs in under 5 minutes

title: Multimodal RAG over PDFs with charts, tables and images
goal: Answer questions about reports where the answer lives in a table or chart, with page citations.
steps: Parse PDFs into text, Markdown tables and figure captions
Build a ColPali page index alongside the text index
Fuse with reciprocal rank fusion and rerank
Answer with a VLM given top page images and text
Cite page numbers and regions
done: 40 questions split prose/table/chart with accuracy reported per type
Chart questions ≥ 70% correct
Every answer cites a page

title: Computer-vision receipt reader that logs expenses
goal: Snap a receipt; get validated JSON logged to an expenses table.
stack: VLM with structured outputs or Textract AnalyzeExpense
steps: Define a receipt schema with decimal money
Extract with a VLM in structured-output mode
Validate arithmetic, dates, currency
Route failures to a review list
Log valid records to the expenses table
done: 50 labeled receipts: field accuracy ≥ 95% on total and date
Validation catches all seeded inconsistent totals
Cost per receipt reported

title: Model routing: cheap vs smart
goal: Route each request to the cheapest model that gets it right, and prove the savings.
steps: Score both models on a golden set
Implement rules-based routing, then a cascade with a verifier
Log route, cost and quality per request
Compare routed vs always-large on quality and cost
Alert on escalation-rate drift
done: Quality within 2 points of always-large on the golden set
Cost reduction measured and reported
Every request logs its route and reason

title: Observability dashboard: per-request cost, latency and failures
goal: See every agent request's cost, latency, tokens and failure reason.
steps: Instrument model, tool and retrieval spans
Attach run_id, user, tenant, cost and outcome
Build fleet and per-agent dashboards
Add burn-rate and cost-spike alerts
Inject failures and confirm they show up
done: Any user complaint can be traced to its run in under a minute
Injected timeout, loop and bad retrieval are all visible
Cost per request shown per agent

title: Guardrails blocking prompt injection and PII leaks
goal: Defense-in-depth around an agent: input and output checks plus containment.
steps: Threat-model the agent and its tools
Add PII detection and redaction on inputs, outputs and traces
Add injection detection on tool outputs
Enforce tool permissions outside the model
Red-team with 50 payloads and measure attack success
done: Attack success rate reported before and after
No PII in stored traces
A classifier miss still cannot exfiltrate data (containment test)

title: Research agent that writes cold emails
goal: Given a company, research it and draft a personalized, accurate outreach email for human review.
steps: Plan research steps with a budget
Search, fetch and extract facts with source URLs
Draft an email citing only verified facts
Score drafts with a judge for accuracy and tone
Queue drafts for human approval; never auto-send
done: Every factual claim links to a source
Hallucinated-fact rate < 5% on 30 companies
Step and cost caps enforced per run

title: Context budget allocator
goal: Build a library that assembles prompts under a token budget and logs what it compressed or dropped.
stack: An LLM API with prompt caching
steps: Define buckets: output reserve, fixed, retrieval, history, memory
Count tokens exactly and allocate by priority
Compress overflow: summarize turns, prune stale tool output
Order stable content first for caching
Log a budget report per call
stretch: Learn bucket ratios from eval results
done: Never exceeds window on 1,000 synthetic conversations
Cache hit rate ≥ 70% on repeated sessions
Answer quality on golden set within 2 points of the uncompressed baseline

title: MCP server with raw JSON-RPC (no SDK)
goal: Implement an MCP server over stdio by hand to learn the wire protocol.
steps: Read newline-delimited JSON-RPC from stdin
Handle initialize and notifications/initialized
Implement tools/list and tools/call for 2 tools
Return JSON-RPC errors for bad input
Test with MCP Inspector and a real client
done: Works in at least one MCP client
Conformance on malformed requests (correct error codes)
Under 300 lines, no SDK

title: Streaming agent UI
goal: Build a chat UI that streams tokens and tool calls with cancellation and optimistic updates.
steps: Stream tokens over SSE
Show tool calls as they start
Render partial JSON safely
Add a cancel button wired to the server
Reconnect and resume after network drops
done: Time to first token under 800 ms p50
Cancel stops generation server-side within 300 ms
Survives network toggle without losing the transcript

title: LoRA fine-tune in your voice
goal: Fine-tune a small open model to write like you, and prove it beats prompting.
steps: Collect and clean 1-5k examples of your writing (with consent for others' text)
Format as instruction pairs
Train a LoRA adapter
Blind-compare against few-shot prompting
Serve the adapter with vLLM multi-LoRA
stretch: DPO on preferred vs rejected drafts
done: Blind preference test: adapter wins ≥ 60% vs prompting
Training cost and time reported
No private data leaked in samples

title: Voice agent answering calls for a local business
goal: A phone receptionist that answers FAQs, books appointments and transfers to a human.
stack: Deepgram/AssemblyAI + ElevenLabs/Cartesia, or a realtime speech-to-speech model
steps: Set up telephony and media streaming
Wire STT → LLM with tools → TTS, streaming
Add semantic turn detection and barge-in
Add booking and warm transfer tools
Measure latency and run 20 scripted calls
done: p95 voice-to-voice latency ≤ 1 s
Barge-in stops audio in ≤ 200 ms
≥ 90% task success on scripted calls; recording disclosure played

title: AI-ready data product with CDC
goal: Turn one domain into fresh, contracted, permission-aware data an agent can use.
steps: Stream changes into gold tables
Write an ODCS contract and tests
Index documents with ACLs and sync deletes
Expose via an MCP server
Ship an eval set with the product
done: p95 freshness ≤ 30 s
Revoked document unretrievable within SLO
Another agent uses it without help

title: Durable long-running agent workflow
goal: An agent that survives crashes, waits for human approval and never double-acts.
steps: Model the task as workflow + activities
Add retries, timeouts and idempotency keys
Add a human approval signal
Kill workers mid-run and verify resume
Add per-tenant concurrency limits
done: Resumes without repeating completed LLM calls
Zero duplicate side effects under chaos test
Fairness test across tenants passes

title: Kill switches and budgets for an agent fleet
goal: Stop runaway agents in seconds and cap spend.
steps: Add tool, agent, tenant and global-autonomy switches
Enforce step/token/time caps per run
Set per-tenant daily budgets
Write runbooks for 5 incident types
Run a game day with a simulated loop
done: Switch takes effect in < 10 s
Runaway loop capped at the budget
Game-day postmortem written

title: Policy-as-code gate for agent tools
goal: Make tool permissions and deploy rules executable and auditable.
steps: Write tool-call policies with allow/deny/require-approval
Unit-test every rule
Check agent manifests in CI
Log every decision with policy version
Roll out in dry-run first
done: 100% of tool calls pass through the engine
Policy tests in CI
Decision log reconstructs any run's permissions

title: Self-correcting agentic RAG
goal: Upgrade a RAG app with query rewriting, grading, retries and abstention.
steps: Add contextual retrieval when indexing
Rewrite and decompose queries
Grade chunks; retry with a new query up to 2 times
Route to web search when the corpus fails
Abstain with explanation at the cap
done: Report first-pass, recovery and abstention rates
Accuracy on answered questions ≥ baseline + 10 points
No unbounded loops (cap enforced in tests)

title: Three-tier agent memory
goal: Give an assistant working, episodic and semantic memory with scoring and eviction.
steps: Store episodes with timestamps
Extract facts into semantic memory
Score by relevance, recency and importance
Evict and consolidate on a schedule
Add a user view and delete UI
done: Recalls planted facts after 50 turns ≥ 90%
Deleted memories never resurface
Memory store bounded in size

title: Audit trail and EU AI Act evidence pack
goal: Prove what your agent did and map it to obligations.
stack: S3 Object Lock or immutable storage
steps: Define an audit event schema
Emit events with run IDs to WORM storage
Minimize PII
Build run-reconstruction queries
Map fields to EU AI Act Art. 12, ISO 42001 and SOC 2
done: Any run reconstructable from its ID
Tampering detected by the hash chain
Evidence pack generated per agent

title: Secure agent landing zone
goal: Deploy an agent with least privilege, private networking and no static keys.
steps: Workload identity per agent
Private endpoints to model API and data
Egress allowlist proxy
KMS-encrypted vector store
Scan and fix posture findings
done: No static credentials anywhere
Simulated exfiltration blocked at network layer
Clean CSPM scan

title: Agent trajectory eval sandbox
goal: Measure agent reliability with end-state checks and pass^k.
steps: Build a sandbox with seeded data and policies
Write 40 tasks with verifiable end states
Add trajectory assertions
Run each task 5 times
Report pass@1, pass^5, steps and cost
done: pass^5 reported with confidence intervals
Failures categorized by type
One prompt change's reliability/cost trade-off shown

title: Self-hosted inference with autoscaling
goal: Serve an open model on Kubernetes within an SLO and know its $/1M tokens.
steps: Deploy vLLM with a pinned model
Load test for TTFT and tokens/s
Autoscale on queue depth
Add gateway routing and fallback
Compute $/1M tokens at 3 loads
done: p95 TTFT within target at planned RPS
Scale-up time measured
Cost model published

title: End-to-end FDE engagement (capstone)
goal: Take a real workflow from discovery to a handed-over production pilot.
stack: Everything above, chosen to fit the customer
steps: Shadow a workflow and scope one use case with a metric
Prototype on real-shaped data in days
Build evals, connectors, tracing and guardrails
Pass a security review
Pilot, measure and hand over with runbooks
done: Baseline vs pilot metric reported
Customer team operates it without you
Runbooks, dashboards and eval suite delivered

title: DPO feedback flywheel
goal: Turn thumbs-down feedback into preference pairs and a nightly DPO LoRA with eval gates.
steps: Log responses with versions
Capture thumbs-down and accepted regenerations as pairs
Filter, scrub PII, deduplicate
Train a LoRA with DPO nightly
Promote only if offline evals and shadow tests win
done: End-to-end run on 1,000 synthetic pairs
Promotion gate blocks a deliberately worse adapter
Lineage from each pair to the adapter version

title: Public teardown, ADRs and benchmark
goal: Publish evidence of engineering judgment: ADRs, a system teardown and a reproducible benchmark.
steps: Write 5 ADRs for one of your ladder projects
Write a teardown: problem, architecture, evals, costs, failures
Publish a benchmark with dataset, harness and settings
Ask a peer to reproduce it
Revise based on feedback
stretch: Teardown of a public product's AI feature
done: A peer reproduces your numbers within noise
Each ADR lists alternatives and consequences
Teardown includes cost per task
